resources.string: Google needs an additional verification before copying your account to the watch. Complete it below, or cancel the transfer.
Copy a Google account to your watch
Google Pixel Watch requested this transfer. Choose the account to copy to the connected watch. Your phone will ask you to confirm its screen lock before account access is transferred.
Confirm your identity to copy the selected Google account to the connected watch.
Keep this screen open while the account is prepared and copied to your watch. You can cancel at any time.
